name: @kauro/adapters-paypal
description: Kauro PayPal adapters (package B15): the PROVIDER binding of the PaymentProviderAdapter port over PayPal Orders v2 and Payments v2, and of the WebhookVerifier port over PayPal's verify-webhook-signature postback. No runtime dependency: HTTP goes through an injected transport (fetch by default), so tests run against a recorded wire built from PayPal's official API examples and never reach the network; the live sandbox runs only under KAURO_LIVE_SANDBOX=1.
